medsl_president.name: County Presidential Election Returns
medsl_president.organization: MIT Election Data and Science Lab
medsl_president.description: County-level returns for U.S. presidential elections from 2000 to 2024, compiled by the MIT Election Data and Science Lab. Alaska reports results by election district and is included at the state level only. Connecticut is reported for its eight former counties. Kansas City, Missouri, is reported separately in the source and is included in Jackson County here.
